Weslock 7651, Single Cylinder Tramore Handleset

The Tramore Arched Handleset will be sure to make an impression. The arched edges are a picture of elegance and subtle beauty. No matter which of the finishes you choose, the Tramore handleset will add a touch of simple richness to your doors. Easy to install, the Weslock Tramore Single Cylinder Handleset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, the outside trim handleset not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the lever operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Molten Bronze Collection which features easy installation as well as lifetime mechanical and finish warranties and meet ANSI grade 2 lock standards.

Features of the Tramore Handleset:

  • Material: solid molten bronze.
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with either 1-5/8" or 2-1/8" top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

    • Specifications of the Weslock Tramore Single Cylinder Entryset:

    • Exterior Length: 10-1/8"
    • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
    • Interior Length: 10-3/16"
    • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
    • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
    • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/4" to 2"; with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
    • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

    The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
